005package org.wpilib.hardware.hal;
006
007/**
008 * CAN API Types.
009 *
010 * <p>This class defines enums for CAN device types and manufacturer IDs as specified in the WPILib
011 * documentation: https://docs.wpilib.org/en/stable/docs/software/can-devices/can-addressing.html
012 */
013@SuppressWarnings("PMD.MissingStaticMethodInNonInstantiatableClass")
014public final class CANAPITypes {
015  /**
016   * FIRST CAN device type.
017   *
018   * <p>This enum represents different types of CAN devices. Teams are encouraged to use the
019   * MISCELLANEOUS for custom or miscellaneous devices.
020   *
021   * @see <a href=
022   *     "https://docs.wpilib.org/en/stable/docs/software/can-devices/can-addressing.html">CAN
023   *     Device Types</a>
024   */
025  public enum CANDeviceType {
026    /** Broadcast. */
027    BROADCAST(0),
028    /** Robot controller. */
029    ROBOT_CONTROLLER(1),
030    /** Motor controller. */
031    MOTOR_CONTROLLER(2),
032    /** Relay controller. */
033    RELAY_CONTROLLER(3),
034    /** Gyro sensor. */
035    GYRO_SENSOR(4),
036    /** Accelerometer. */
037    ACCELEROMETER(5),
038    /** Distance sensor. */
039    DISTANCE_SENSOR(6),
040    /** Encoder. */
041    ENCODER(7),
042    /** Power distribution. */
043    POWER_DISTRIBUTION(8),
044    /** Pneumatics. */
045    PNEUMATICS(9),
046    /** Miscellaneous. */
047    MISCELLANEOUS(10),
048    /** IO breakout. */
049    IO_BREAKOUT(11),
050    /** Servo Controller. */
051    SERVO_CONTROLLER(12),
052    /** Color Sensor. */
053    COLOR_SENSOR(13),
054    /** Firmware update. */
055    FIRMWARE_UPDATE(31);
056
057    /** The device type ID. */
058    public final int id;
059
060    CANDeviceType(int id) {
061      this.id = id;
062    }
063  }
064
065  /**
066   * FIRST CAN manufacturer ID.
067   *
068   * <p>This enum represents different manufacturer IDs for CAN devices. Teams are encouraged to use
069   * the TEAM_USE manufacturer ID for custom or team-specific devices.
070   *
071   * @see <a href=
072   *     "https://docs.wpilib.org/en/stable/docs/software/can-devices/can-addressing.html">CAN
073   *     Manufacturer IDs</a>
074   */
075  public enum CANManufacturer {
076    /** Broadcast. */
077    BROADCAST(0),
078    /** National Instruments. */
079    NI(1),
080    /** Limelight. */
081    LIMELIGHT(2),
082    /** FIRST. */
083    FIRST(3),
084    /** Cross the Road Electronics. */
085    CTRE(4),
086    /** REV Robotics. */
087    REV(5),
088    /** Grapple. */
089    GRAPPLE(6),
090    /** MindSensors. */
091    MS(7),
092    /** Team use. */
093    TEAM_USE(8),
094    /** Kauai Labs. */
095    KAUAI_LABS(9),
096    /** Copperforge. */
097    COPPERFORGE(10),
098    /** Playing With Fusion. */
099    PWF(11),
100    /** Studica. */
101    STUDICA(12),
102    /** TheThriftyBot. */
103    THRIFTYBOT(13),
104    /** Redux Robotics. */
105    REDUX_ROBOTICS(14),
106    /** AndyMark. */
107    ANDYMARK(15),
108    /** Vivid-Hosting. */
109    VIVID_HOSTING(16),
110    /** Vertos Robotics. */
111    VERTOS_ROBOTICS(17),
112    /** SWYFT Robotics. */
113    SWYFT_ROBOTICS(18),
114    /** Lumyn Labs. */
115    LUMYN_LABS(19),
116    /** Brushland Labs. */
117    BRUSHLAND_LABS(20);
118
119    /** The manufacturer ID. */
120    public final int id;
121
122    CANManufacturer(int id) {
123      this.id = id;
124    }
125  }
126
127  /** Utility class. */
128  private CANAPITypes() {}
129}
